messages:
sam: Heads-up: prod eu embeddings service returning intermittent 502s. Traced to a kafka consumer offset commit race. Quick hotfix ready (eu-embed:0.0.4). Need expedited deploy in the open change window — canary or skip canary? /cc @ops_lead @maya

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: deploy-1698765432-eu-embed-hotfix by sam. Target: eu-west1. Image: eu-embed:0.0.4. Canary: default 10% (override allowed). Reviewers: ops_lead, maya

maya: What's the rollback plan if kv pump or consumer lag spikes? last time we saw a ~15% error climb

sam: Rollback = pin back to 0.0.3 via deploybot rollback command. Health checks: 200 /health, embed tail latency <50ms, errors <0.5% over 60s. I ran staging smoke — all green. Fix is in `consumer.commit()` ordering change.

ops_lead: @sam can we skip canary and do immediate full? We have a 2hr SLA window to meet customer SLAs

ryan: Also need a one-line release note for changelog and a short customer-facing blurb

linda: staging smoke link? I can validate before greenlight

sam: Staging report: https://ci/reports/169876-sg-1 — all tests passed. Smoke steps: `curl -sS https://staging/eu/embed/health` + consumer sim. Release note suggestion: "fix: embed service 502s due to kafka offset commit race"

ops_lead: I approve expedited deploy. Prefer a short 5% canary for 3m then ramp if no errors. :thumbsup:

maya: Agree with 5% canary. If errors >1% for 3m, we rollback.

sam: Triggering deploybot: `/deploy deploy-1698765432-eu-embed-hotfix --image eu-embed:0.0.4 --canary 5% --canary-duration 180s --notes "fix: embed service 502s"`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary at 5%. Monitoring metrics. Logs: /deploy/logs/1698765432. Notifying oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary result: 0 errors in 180s, avg latency 32ms. Ramping to 50%.

deploy-bot: Ramp result: stable at 50% for 120s. Ramping to 100%.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: eu-west1 -> eu-embed:0.0.4, rollout 100%. If issues, run `/deploy rollback deploy-1698765432-eu-embed-hotfix`

ops_lead: Marked as pinned release in release tracker. Can someone add the change note to release-notes.md?

ryan: I'll add it. Customer blurb: "We've fixed intermittent 502s in embeddings; rollout completed in EU. If you see any issues, contact support."

linda: Verified prod traces and error budget — all green. Closing the change window. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all. Follow-up: I'll open a PR to add the commit to the changelog and update the postmortem template with 'default 5% short canary for expedited hotfixes'
